h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jaunpur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Jaunpur

c: Buyers in a district town like Jaunpur often ask us what exactly they get for their money, and the warranty is a fair place to start. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years, while bearings, springs and spare parts carry 1 year. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, municipal parks and housing colonies in Jaunpur, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,230 km away.

The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the machines are installed and maintained as per our instructions. That is why we hand over simple care steps after installation. Jaunpur, on the Gomti in eastern Uttar Pradesh, has hot summers, a wet monsoon and foggy winter mornings. We deliver by road and fix the machines through our team or a dealer in north India. Send us the site size and photos for a layout drawing and quote.

items.q: What warranty comes with outdoor gym equipment?
